verdict.rationale: An open banking API provider could plausibly offer an end-user consent dashboard, so this axis applies. The evidence only covers granting consent: Yapily Connect's pre-built consent screens and UX guidelines, plus a re-authorisation endpoint. Those are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here. Nothing in the pack documents a surface or portal where end users view and revoke which apps hold access to their bank data, nor even a consent-revocation API.
